```plato

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 construction — billboards
    //
    // Placements that keep a flat object turned toward the camera.

    // The spherical billboard at `objectPosition`: the object's +Z is turned to
    // face the camera outright. When the camera sits on the object (within 1e-4
    // squared units) the camera's own forward direction is used instead.
    CreateBillboard(_: Matrix4x4, objectPosition: Point3D, cameraPosition: Point3D, cameraUpVector: Vector3D, cameraForwardVector: Vector3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var eps = 0.0001;
        var toObject = cameraPosition.Between(objectPosition);
        var zaxis = toObject.LengthSquared < eps ? -cameraForwardVector : toObject.Normalize;
        var xaxis = cameraUpVector.Cross(zaxis).Normalize;
        var yaxis = zaxis.Cross(xaxis);
        return (Number4(xaxis.X, xaxis.Y, xaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(yaxis.X, yaxis.Y, yaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(zaxis.X, zaxis.Y, zaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(objectPosition.X, objectPosition.Y, objectPosition.Z, 1.0));
    }

    // The cylindrical billboard at `objectPosition`: the object turns toward the
    // camera about `rotateAxis` only, so the axis is preserved exactly. When the
    // facing direction is within a tenth of a degree of the axis the turn is
    // undefined, and the object's own forward — or, failing that, a fixed world
    // axis — is substituted.
    CreateConstrainedBillboard(_: Matrix4x4, objectPosition: Point3D, cameraPosition: Point3D, rotateAxis: Vector3D, cameraForwardVector: Vector3D, objectForwardVector: Vector3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var eps = 0.0001;
        // The cosine beyond which two unit vectors count as parallel.
        var minAngle = 1.0 - 0.1 * Number.RadiansPerDegree;
        var toObject = cameraPosition.Between(objectPosition);
        var faceDir = toObject.LengthSquared < eps ? -cameraForwardVector : toObject.Normalize;
        var yaxis = rotateAxis;
        var degenerate = rotateAxis.Dot(faceDir).Abs > minAngle;
        var fallback = rotateAxis.Dot(objectForwardVector).Abs > minAngle
            ? (rotateAxis.Z.Abs > minAngle ? Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0) : Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, -1.0))
            : objectForwardVector;
        var xaxis = degenerate
            ? rotateAxis.Cross(fallback).Normalize
            : rotateAxis.Cross(faceDir).Normalize;
        // Both branches of the original close the basis the same way, since
        // yaxis is rotateAxis.
        var zaxis = xaxis.Cross(rotateAxis).Normalize;
        return (Number4(xaxis.X, xaxis.Y, xaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(yaxis.X, yaxis.Y, yaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(zaxis.X, zaxis.Y, zaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(objectPosition.X, objectPosition.Y, objectPosition.Z, 1.0));
    }
}
```
